title: agent.tool_call.v1
description: Consumed from Fabric when an agent invokes a tool during capability execution. Used by ExecutionMonitor for substep tracking.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance.

trace_id.description: ORCH-09: cognitive trace ID propagated on all events.

agent_id.description: Agent instance identifier performing the tool call.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool being invoked.

step_id.description: DAG step identifier the agent is executing.
